entities.summary: Winning Jah (b. 1973-12-12, Kano) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Kano and Nigeria. Known in the fields of nigeria, composers & musicians, africa.
